text: 商务部等8部门印发《促进智能家居消费行动方案》，其中指出，支持地方结合实际自主合理确定智能家居产品补贴品类、补贴标准，统筹支持全屋智能家居购新。鼓励金融机构围绕家居家装等消费需求，开发多样化的消费金融产品与服务。用好个人消费贷款财政贴息政策，引导金融机构加大对智能家居消费等贷款支持力度，积极支持消费者购买智能家居相关产品。
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments issued the Action Plan for Promoting Smart Home Consumption, which states that local governments will be supported in independently and reasonably determining subsidy categories and subsidy standards for smart home products based on local conditions, and in coordinating support for the purchase of new whole-home smart home systems. Financial institutions are encouraged to develop diversified consumer finance products and services around consumption needs such as home furnishing and home decoration. The fiscal interest subsidy policy for personal consumer loans should be well utilized to guide financial institutions in increasing loan support for smart home consumption and to actively support consumers in purchasing smart home-related products.
